items.title: Japan to invest $21 billion in up to two GlobalFoundries chip factories in New York
items.author: Stephen Nellis, David Shepardson, Makiko Yamazaki
items.creator: Stephen Nellis, David Shepardson, Makiko Yamazaki
items.summary: Japan will invest about $21 billion to build up to two chip factories in New York State that will be jointly owned by the US government and Japanese interests and operated by GlobalFoundries , the company said on Wednesday.
items.body:
Japan will invest about $21 billion to build up to two chip factories in New York State that will be jointly owned by the US government and Japanese interests and operated by GlobalFoundries (GFS.O) , the company said on Wednesday.
The initiative is part of a Trump administration deal struck last year for Japan to invest $550 billion in the US in return for the US lowering tariffs on Japanese cars and other imports from at least 25% to 15%.
Shares of Malta, New York-based GlobalFoundries, which is majority-owned by Abu Dhabi's sovereign wealth fund Mubadala Investment Co, rose more than 4% in afternoon trading. They have gained more than 39% this year.
Construction of the first factory is scheduled to begin this year with chip production expected in 2029. GlobalFoundries executives said the partners will decide whether to build the second factory before the end of 2028.
The first factory is expected to add annual US manufacturing capacity for about 900,000 300mm wafers when fully operational, ranking it among the larger US semiconductor manufacturing facilities, and create more than 1,000 factory jobs in New York.
The US government previously held a 3% stake in GlobalFoundries. GlobalFoundries CEO Tim Breen told Reuters that will rise to 7%. Japan will provide all of the investment capital under the deal.
US President Donald Trump said on Truth Social the US government, which provided $1.63 billion in grants to the company, values the 7% stake in the company at more than $2 billion.
"We are the first administration ever to turn grants into money for America," Trump said.
Breen told Reuters initial customers for the New York factories include Japan's Renesas Electronics (6723.T) and iPhone maker Apple (AAPL.O) .
On a conference call with investors, executives said the new deal will generate fees for the company for at least 20 years. This revenue is expected to be $50 million next year, when the company will earn fees for managing construction of the first factory.
GlobalFoundries will shift $955 million previously awarded by the US government to accelerate investments in silicon photonics, silicon-germanium chip material and advanced packaging at its existing chip factories in Malta, New York, and Burlington, Vermont.
GlobalFoundries' Breen said that at least some of the capital investment by Japan will flow back to chip-manufacturing toolmakers such as Tokyo Electron (8035.T) and other Japanese firms that along with US rivals dominate the supply chain.
"Obviously, we have a strong interest in the Japanese equipment suppliers to be part of it," Breen said. "We will be very open-minded, but we'll definitely engage very much with the Japanese ecosystem because they have great technologies."
Japan has so far announced two batches of projects worth over $100 billion combined under the overall investment scheme.
Under the arrangement with the US, Trump selects projects to be funded by Japan. Available free cash flows from investments will be [USN:L1N42R099 TEXT:"split evenly"] between the two countries until a specific allocation is reached, after which 90% will go to the US.

Oct 14 : Hyundai Motor India plans to invest 110 billion rupees ($1.16 billion) in its Pune city plant to scale up the facility's annual production capacity by nearly 90 per cent by 2030, the automaker said on Wednesday. 
The move comes a day after parent Hyundai Motor Group said it would invest $15.5 billion in India through 2032, positioning the world's third-largest car market as a key growth market. 
India is drawing billions of dollars in commitments from global automakers eager to capture rising consumer demand and strengthen their manufacturing footprints.

• The Indian unit also said it would incorporate AI-powered operations, including quality inspection and defect detection systems.

items.title: Liquidia surges as United Therapeutics settlement removes key litigation risk
items.author: Siddhi Mahatole
items.creator: Siddhi Mahatole
items.summary: Liquidia shares jumped 26% on Wednesday after it settled a years-long legal dispute with United Therapeutics over its lung disease drug, removing a major litigation risk for the drugmaker.
items.body:
Liquidia (LQDA.O) shares jumped 26% on Wednesday after it settled a years-long legal dispute with United Therapeutics (UTHR.O) over its lung disease drug, removing a major litigation risk for the drugmaker.
The settlement, announced late on Tuesday, ends six lawsuits over patents, trade secrets, contracts and antitrust claims related to Liquidia's Yutrepia, an inhaled dry-powder form of the drug treprostinil.
"The agreement avoids more negative scenarios that had previously been priced in for Liquidia shares," said Needham analyst Serge Belanger. The drugmaker's shares had lost [USN:L4N45M1L4 TEXT:"more than half"] their value after an adverse court ruling last month.
Yutrepia is approved to treat pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) and pulmonary hypertension linked to interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD), and competes in the market with United Therapeutics' Tyvaso.
As part of the settlement, Liquidia will stop promoting its drug for PH-ILD, but will keep selling it for PAH. It will also pay United Therapeutics about $380.7 million in installments through 2027.
"We expect to fund the outlined payments from the ongoing sales of Yutrepia and cash on hand," Chief Financial Officer Michael Kaseta said.
Liquidia has also asked the US Food and Drug Administration to remove PH-ILD from Yutrepia's label.
Meanwhile, United Therapeutics said it has "established programs to help enable eligible patients to quickly and seamlessly transition to nebulized Tyvaso or Tyvaso DPI without interruption for their treatment."
The settlement is largely favorable to both companies, according to analysts. "With the legal overhang removed, we now view Liquidia primarily as a Yutrepia growth story in PAH, with upside from label expansion plus significant pipeline opportunities from L606," Jefferies analyst Manoj Eradath said.
L606 is Liquidia's experimental lung disease drug, currently in late-stage development.
Although the outcome was on par with investor expectations, the roughly $380 million payment was "better than expected" for United Therapeutics, according to J.P. Morgan analyst Jessica Fye.
It would also likely improve visibility into future Tyvaso growth in PH-ILD, said Jefferies analyst Roger Song.
Shares of United Therapeutics were down nearly 1% in morning trading.
Meanwhile, Liquidia will terminate trial cohorts studying PH-ILD and cease publication of related data as part of the settlement, according to a regulatory filing by United Therapeutics.

items.title: Yemen fighting overwhelms hospitals, cuts aid to 800,000 people, relief agencies say
items.author: CNA
items.summary: GENEVA: Hospitals across Yemen are struggling to cope with a sharp rise in war casualties, while intensified fighting along multiple front lines has cut off aid to around 800,000 people, humanitarian agencies

Yemen fighting overwhelms hospitals, cuts aid to 800,000 people, relief agencies say

FAST

GENEVA: Hospitals across Yemen are struggling to cope with a sharp rise in war casualties, while intensified fighting along multiple front lines has cut off aid to around 800,000 people, humanitarian agencies said on Wednesday (Oct 14).

Front-line hospitals in areas including Marib, Taiz and Yemen's Red Sea coast are seeing unprecedented numbers of weapon-wounded patients, with some facilities admitting more than 700 casualties in a single week, according to the Red Cross.

More than 200,000 people have been displaced from their homes since fighting in the country began in recent weeks, sparked by renewed fighting between the Iran-backed Houthi group and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen, according to the United Nations' International Organization for Migration.

A displaced Yemeni child sits under a tree as families gather to receive aid at the Al-Fallahine displacement camp in Dar Saad district, Aden, Yemen on Oct 12, 2026. (Photo: AP/Abdulnasser Alseddik)

"Trauma care staff are under enormous pressure," ICRC health coordinator Feras Abusamra said in a statement. Only a small proportion of Yemen's functioning health facilities are capable of providing comprehensive trauma care, he said, while hospitals face large numbers of wounded people amid shortages of surgical supplies, anesthesia, oxygen and medicines.

Yemen's health services, battered by more than a decade of conflict, economic crisis, displacement and disease outbreaks, may have limited capacity to absorb a new surge in mass casualties if fighting intensifies further, the ICRC warned.

The fighting has also cut off life-saving humanitarian assistance for 800,000 people in Taiz - Yemen's third-largest city, which currently hosts the largest number of people fleeing the fighting - and other areas impacted by the conflict, the UN World Food Programme said on Wednesday.

Some districts are now inaccessible because of fighting and road closures, the WFP said, adding that wheat flour stocks are nearly exhausted and remaining food in local markets may last only a short time.

"This is the kind of situation that can rapidly spiral into a humanitarian catastrophe if assistance cannot move safely and reach those who need it most," said El-Khidir Daloum, WFP Representative and Country Director in Yemen, in a statement.

items.title: ＡＩ暴走は「早期警告」、国際基準機関必要とディープマインドのハサビス氏
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Padraic Halpin　Foo Yun Chee

［ダブリン　１４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Padraic Halpin　Foo Yun Chee

［ダブリン　１４日　ロイター］ - 米グーグルの人工知能（ＡＩ）開発部門グーグルディープマインドの創業者で会長のデミス・ハサビス氏は１４日、ＡＩエージェントによる最近のハッキング事案は「早期の警告」だとし、システムの安全性を高めなければ、世界は近く重大な事案に直面する恐れがあると警告した。

オープンＡＩやアンソロピックのＡＩエージェントの「暴走」が相次ぎ明らかになっている。

ハサビス氏はダブリンで開かれたＡＩサミットで「（ハッキング事案は）われわれにとって早期の警告だ」と述べた。システムがまだそれほど強力ではないため、事案もそれほど重大ではないが「業界として、また個々の企業や政府がシステムの安全確保にさらに取り組まなければ、来年（２０２７年）やその先の数年を見据えると、（重大な事案に）なる可能性がある」と指摘した。

生物学や原子力など他の分野では重要なシステムを守るためのベストプラクティス（最善の慣行）が取り入れられているとし、ＡＩでそれを導入するには「やるべきことが多い」と指摘。いずれ何らかの国際的な基準策定機関が必要になるとの考えを示した。

同氏はグーグルの親会社アルファベットの最高科学責任者も務めている。２０２４年には、タンパク質の設計と構造予測でノーベル化学賞を受賞した。

マイクロソフトのブラッド・スミス社長は同じ会議で、ＡＩの不正な振る舞いによって２０２６年は「厳しい現実を思い知らされた年」になったと述べた。安全性を技術革新に追いつかせるため、ＡＩの安全性に関する新たな法律や規則が早急に必要だと指摘した。

「いかなる企業や技術も法を超越すべきではない。われわれには法律が必要であり、規制が必要だ。規制は合理的でバランスが取れたものでなければならず、技術革新も考慮しなければならない」と述べた。

「業界の一部には規制アレルギーがあるが、克服する必要がある」とした。

ハサビス氏は、国際的な基準策定機関の設置は当然の対応策に見えるとした上で、技術革新を阻害しないよう、きめ細かく機動的なものにする必要があると述べた。

「つまり基本的には、われわれが認識するリスクに見合い、技術の進む方向に応じて素早く変えられるような認証の仕組みを、柔軟に築いていく必要がある」と語った。

items.title: 日中韓の中銀総裁、バンコクで会合開催　経済・金融情勢で意見交換
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Takahiko Wada

［東京　１４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Takahiko Wada

［東京　１４日　ロイター］ - 日銀は１４日、中国、韓国と３カ国の中央銀行総裁会合を開いたと発表した。タイのバンコクで開催中の世界銀行・国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）総会に合わせ、同日会談した。

韓国銀行の申鉉松総裁が議長を務め、中国人民銀行の潘功勝総裁、日銀の植田和男総裁が出席して最近の経済・金融情勢について意見交換した。

同会合は定期的に開催されており、今回が１５回目。次回は来年、中国人民銀が主催する予定。

items.title: 米ＦＲＢ、追加措置を急ぐ必要ない＝ボウマン副議長
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Selena Li

[バンコク １４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Selena Li

[バンコク １４日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のボウマン副議長（金融監督担当）は１４日、追加措置を決定する前に、前回の利上げ後の金融市場や経済の動向を見極める時間的余裕があるとの見方を示した。

ボウマン氏はバンコクで開催されている国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行会合の際に「現時点で追加行動を急ぐ必要は感じていない。時間をかけて、状況がどう変化していくかを見極める必要がある」と述べた。

人工知能（ＡＩ）が銀行にもたらすサイバーセキュリティー上のリスクに関する議論とは別に、ＦＲＢはデータセンターの開発・建設に実際に投じられる銀行をはじめとする資金源からの資金にも目を向けていると指摘。「銀行システムへの監督・規制を通じて、将来の経済を支える資金が確保される必要がある」と語った。

また、自ら指示したシリコンバレー銀行の２０２３年の破綻に関する検証を踏まえ、監督を改善してＦＲＢ内の説明責任を強化するための「全面的な組織再編」を求めた。

人工知能（ＡＩ）が銀行にもたらすサイバーセキュリティー上のリスクに関する議論とは別に、ＦＲＢはデータセンターの開発・建設に実際に投じられる銀行をはじめとする資金源からの資金にも目を向けていると指摘。「銀行システムへの監督・規制を通じて、将来の経済を支える資金が確保される必要がある」と語った。

また、自ら指示したシリコンバレー銀行の２０２３年の破綻に関する検証を踏まえ、監督を改善してＦＲＢ内の説明責任を強化するための「全面的な組織再編」を求めた。

items.title: Trump tariff threat built a US copper mountain, but the effects are fading
items.author: Pratima Desai
items.creator: Pratima Desai
items.summary: President Donald Trump’s tariff threat helped to build copper stockpiles of more than 1 million metric tons in the United States without spending public money, but the flow is slowing as traders await a decision on the levies.
items.body:
President Donald Trump’s tariff threat helped to build copper stockpiles of more than 1 million metric tons in the United States without spending public money, but the flow is slowing as traders await a decision on the levies.
The prospect of levies has left Comex-approved warehouses in the United States holding roughly 70% of the world's visible copper stocks. This has created shortages elsewhere, fuelling a price surge despite a global surplus.
"Only traders are making money. There are cheaper ways they could have got the copper. They could have quietly collected metal around the world from the off-exchange market," said Panmure Liberum analyst Tom Price.
Whether and when tariffs are imposed on US imports and whether the possibility will keep attracting copper will be a key talking point at LME Week, the industry's annual gathering in London, starting on October 18.
Traders have been shipping copper to the United States since Trump ordered a study on the potential for tariffs in February last year, which pushed Comex prices to record highs, reaching $6.83 a lb, or $15,057 a ton, on September 22.
This created a positive arbitrage — a price gap — in favour of Comex over London Metal Exchange copper , once costs including freight and insurance were stripped out.
The arb hit a record peak above $3,000 a ton in July last year. Since then, it has been high enough to make shipping copper to the United States profitable, but not always. The arb is now about $310 a ton.
"The US built a copper stockpile without spending taxpayer money, with policy and an almost existential threat of import levies," said Wood Mackenzie analyst Charles Cooper.
"But the arbitrage has collapsed, so the incentive to keep moving metal to the US is much weaker right now."
JANUARY DECISION DEADLINE LOOMS The US Commerce Department was due to report on the domestic copper market by June 30 so Trump could decide whether to impose a 15% tariff on refined copper imports from January 1, 2027, rising to 30% in 2028.
But no decision has been announced.
One scenario Macquarie analyst Alice Fox sees as most likely is that the January deadline passes without a decision, leaving the question of tariffs unresolved.
"This would likely see the arb come off in the short term but then return to current levels ... not quite high enough to encourage additional metal, but high enough to keep metal in the US," Fox said.
Macquarie estimates that copper stocks in the United States on and off exchange now total about 1.6 million tons.
Since the end of February last year, Comex copper stocks have climbed nearly 750% to more than 714,000 tons.
Copper stored in LME warehouses in New Orleans and Baltimore have jumped 44% since mid-August to nearly 130,000 tons.
Comex, Shanghai Futures Exchange and LME copper stocks overall total more than 1 million tons.
LARGE SURPLUS IN THE US The US now has vastly more copper than it needs, which Panmure Liberum's Price expects to amount to 1.6 million tons this year.
Numbers from information provider Trade Data Monitor show that the US imported more than 1.62 million tons of copper last year, up 80% from 2024.
US Geological Survey pegged US production at 1 million tons last year, which left the US with a surplus. Analysts expect a similar picture this year.
For excess metal to be exported, prices on the LME and the Shanghai Futures Exchange would need to be significantly above those on Comex. This will happen only when shortages outside the United States become critical.
"When traders see surpluses in the US and severe shortages elsewhere, copper prices in the US and on the LME will be priced accordingly," said Price.
items.raw_description: President Donald Trump’s tariff threat helped to build copper stockpiles of more than 1 million metric tons in the United States without spending public money, but the flow is slowing as traders await a decision on the levies.

items.title: Ukraine says SpaceX hampers drones for attack and defence, as US ties fray
items.author: Yuliia Dysa, Dan Peleschuk
items.creator: Yuliia Dysa, Dan Peleschuk
items.summary: Ukraine said Elon Musk's SpaceX had limited its satellite services on Wednesday, hampering Ukrainian drones for attack missions and air defences, as relations between Kyiv and Washington have taken a sharp turn for the worse.
items.body:
Ukraine said Elon Musk's SpaceX had limited its satellite services on Wednesday, hampering Ukrainian drones for attack missions and air defences, as relations between Kyiv and Washington have taken a sharp turn for the worse.
Russia rained more missiles and drones down on Ukrainian cities, knocking out electricity for hundreds of thousands of people in attacks President Volodymyr Zelenskiy called "ostentatious disrespect" to Donald Trump's call for an energy ceasefire.
The US president publicly turned on Zelenskiy in recent days after abruptly lifting sanctions on Russian diesel last week, under political pressure to lower fuel prices that have soared since he launched a war against Iran. He has called on Kyiv to halt attacks on Russian refineries, and said Ukrainians should replace their wartime leader.
"It's painful when President Trump chooses one side, not our side," Zelenskiy told Piers Morgan Uncensored. He said that [USN:L8N46022D TEXT:"he was OK"] with Trump being in the middle of Ukraine and Russia, but added: "If you are in the middle, you have to stay in the middle."
Asked about the restriction on the military version of SpaceX's Starlink services in Ukraine, Zelenskiy said: "It's a big mistake ... this decision will bring a lot of human losses." He did not say who was responsible.
Trump announced at the weekend that Ukraine and Russia both agreed to halt attacks on energy targets, although neither side confirmed this and the past two days have seen intensive Russian bombing, including of Ukrainian power stations.
After a night of bombardment of the capital Kyiv, Russian strikes continued throughout the day on Wednesday with six people killed in the western city of Lutsk, where the regional governor said a warehouse and a residential building were hit.
Ukraine, for its part, continued long-range strikes on Russia, hitting [USN:L8N46009S TEXT:"Russia's biggest data centre"], although it says it is holding back from hitting energy targets for now to show respect for Trump.
NO WARNING BEFORE STARLINK CUTS Ukrainian military officials said Musk's SpaceX (SPCX.O) had without warning started to interrupt functioning of its military-grade terminals when they are moving at high speed.
Kyiv installs SpaceX receptors in many of its drones as part of their onboard guidance systems. The terminals operate across Ukraine, including in territory held by Russian forces.
"Our defence forces did not receive a warning about this limitation, and this led to the disruption of several missions," presidential adviser Serhiy Beskrestnov wrote on Telegram, saying the restriction affected StarShield, SpaceX's military and intelligence service.
The speed cutoff hampers Ukraine's ability to conduct strikes on Russian targets inside Ukraine, or to defend itself from Russian drones using its own interceptor drones, according to a defence ministry source and another military source.
Beskrestnov said SpaceX had imposed a speed limit of 160 km per hour. The defence ministry source told Reuters military units had reported guidance systems losing their connections at speeds of less than half that.
SpaceX did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The defence ministry source said Ukraine was in contact with the company as well as the US government and NATO to seek clarification over the sudden limitations.
The suggestion that Musk's company had limited Ukrainian military capabilities drew a sharp response from Poland, which pays for Ukrainian Starlink subscriptions on Kyiv's behalf.
"Hey, @elonmusk, big man, are you playing politics with your products again?" Polish Foreign Minister Radoslaw Sikorski asked Musk on X. "As your European customers, we are watching you."
There was no immediate response from Musk, who in the past has called Sikorski a "small man".
Shares in European satellite operator Eutelsat (ETL.PA) , which is seen as Europe's best shot at taking on Starlink, [USN:L6N4600QK TEXT:"jumped on Wednesday"] as some investors bet that European providers could benefit from growing strains between Washington and Kyiv.
Musk is a close political ally of Trump, and the suggestion that SpaceX might limit Ukrainian capabilities reinforced wider Ukrainian concerns that Washington could withhold battlefield support to compel its one-time ally to make concessions.
Sources have told Reuters and other media that the US has threatened to cut off intelligence for early warning of missile strikes on Ukraine, to press Kyiv to suspend attacks on Russian oil refineries.
NO WARNING AHEAD OF MISSILES Rescue workers in Kyiv were stretchering the injured from the wreckage of a blasted-out residential building overnight, while firefighters battled a huge blaze in the darkness. Officials said 2 people were killed and 21 wounded at the site.
Some 600,000 people were left without power as Russian missiles careened into power stations during hours of attacks that primarily targeted Kyiv and Kharkiv, Ukraine's second-largest city.
Russia's defence ministry confirmed it had struck four power plants in and around Kyiv and two in Kharkiv, among other targets. Zelenskiy said 30 energy facilities were damaged.
Ukrainian officials said late on Tuesday they had received no warnings from Western partners for a second day before Russian missiles hit the capital. Trump had insisted on Tuesday that Washington was [USN:L1N45Z0GP TEXT:"still sharing intelligence"].
Zelenskiy cast the latest Russian attacks as a deliberate snub to Trump's declaration of a ceasefire on energy targets.
"Russia does not consider the American President's statements strong," Zelenskiy wrote on X. "The strike was entirely deliberate and demonstrative in its scale – Russia has never before shown such ostentatious disrespect toward the United States."
Zelenskiy has said Ukraine is willing to observe an energy ceasefire and has not targeted Russian refineries since Trump announced it, but will not continue to hold back if Russia ignores the purported truce. The Kremlin said on Tuesday that contacts were continuing about an energy truce.
Ukraine reported downing just 4 out of 39 Russian missiles, reflecting Kyiv's weakened air defences against fast-moving ballistic missiles and jet-powered drones amid a shortage of weapons.

items.title: US bank regulator faults several large lenders over debanking practices
items.author: Pete Schroeder, Manya Saini
items.creator: Pete Schroeder, Manya Saini
items.summary: A top US bank regulator issued a report on Wednesday finding some of the country's largest banks unfairly denied services to some clients on political, religious or other grounds, but stopped short of imposing penalties.
items.body:
A top US bank regulator issued a report on Wednesday finding some of the country's largest banks unfairly denied services to some clients on political, religious or other grounds, but stopped short of imposing penalties.
The [USN:L4N4491DY TEXT:"debanking"] report from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency covered nine of the nation's largest banks by asset size. The regulator found each had policies restricting some clients' access to financial services based on subjective criteria rather than financial risk.
Banks have said they close accounts or deny services because of legal, financial or reputational risks, not politics.
The regulator criticized the banks for the practices, but did not indicate any sanctions or punishments were forthcoming. It said it may consider policy changes to discourage such activity.
FAIR ACCESS IS A MANDATE: REGULATOR The review, which began in September 2025, scrutinized banks that collectively hold a majority of US commercial banking assets.
"Americans should have access to financial services regardless of their beliefs, affiliations, or political views. Fair access to financial services is not a mantra — it is a mandate," Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan Gould said in a statement.
After President Donald Trump signed an executive order directing a review of alleged debanking, [USN:L4N42C182 TEXT:"regulators and banks moved to eliminate the use of reputation risk "]in assessing clients, though[USN:L4N4491DY TEXT:" the issue remains contentious. "]
Conservative politicians and business groups have accused banks of cutting off companies in sectors including fossil fuels, firearms and cryptocurrency , making debanking a flashpoint in Washington financial policy.
Large banks have denied rejecting customers on political or religious grounds, arguing instead that years of aggressive regulatory pressure discouraged them from serving certain sectors and urging Washington to establish clearer rules on who they can and cannot serve.
The OCC found that concerns about public opinion had led at least one bank to distance itself from certain customer affiliations that could be viewed as partisan. It added that banks generally lacked clear, measurable standards and objective, risk-based criteria for assessing reputational risks associated with customer relationships.
"The OCC will continue to work with our regulatory partners to further assess the extent to which bank policies implementing money laundering and terrorist financing program requirements have contributed to debanking and will take appropriate action as needed," the report said.
Earlier this year, Trump [USN:L4N3YN1QS TEXT:"filed a $5 billion lawsuit"] against JPMorgan Chase and its CEO Jamie Dimon, alleging the bank closed several of his accounts for political reasons. JPMorgan, the largest US bank, has denied closing accounts on political or religious grounds, and filed a motion to dismiss the lawsuit on Tuesday.
A bank spokesperson said the lender prohibits political and religious discrimination, and added, "Years of operating in a regulatory environment that often second-guessed decisions contributed to a culture of caution across the banking industry. That system needs fixing."
Trump has also [USN:S0N3OG012 TEXT:"accused other lenders"], including Bank of America (BAC.N) , the country's second-biggest lender by assets, of debanking him in early 2025. A Bank of America spokesperson did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the new report. The bank has previously said it does not comment on client matters and would welcome clearer rules from bank regulators on how to conduct its activities.

Thailand can return to 3% growth within 2-3 years, central bank official says

BANGKOK, Oct 14 : Thailand's return to economic growth of about 3 per cent is "definitely possible" within three years if it can tackle some of its structural issues, a deputy central bank governor said on Wednesday, signalling alignment with the government's stance.
The Bank of Thailand's monetary policy will remain accommodative for now and the policy rate, currently at 1.00 per cent, will normalise only when the economy is ready, Piti Disyatat, the deputy governor for monetary stability, told Reuters. 
Piti said he expects the economy to grow 2.3 per cent or slightly higher this year and to expand by 1.8 per cent in 2027. The central bank's baseline scenario is to get back to a 2.8 per cent to 3 per cent range the year after.   
"In the more distant future, two or three years horizon, we do think our potential trend growth is around 2.8 per cent to 3 per cent. So it is definitely possible to grow to 3 per cent and we expect growth to get to that level," he said in an interview on the sidelines of the International Monetary Fund-World Bank annual meetings.

"It's subject to not having negative shocks and also partly subject to some of the constraints that are within our control, the so-called more structural things that can be alleviated."
Backed by a government push for new investments in key sectors such as semiconductors and data centres, Thailand's economy is expected to grow by 2.5 per cent next year and potentially by 3 per cent within the next three years, Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas told Reuters last month.
In an interview last month, Don Nakornthab, Bank of Thailand assistant governor for monetary policy, said the Thai economy's potential growth rate stood at 2.7 per cent, which would take four to five years to reach.
RATE CUT 'HARD TO IMAGINE'
Southeast Asia's second-largest economy has struggled in recent years compared to other countries in the region, weighed down by weak demand and stubbornly high levels of household debt.
The economy expanded 1.9 per cent annually in the second quarter of 2026, down sharply from 2.8 per cent in the previous quarter.
The central bank left its key interest rate unchanged at 1.00 per cent in August and cut its policy rate six times between October 2024 and February, amounting to a total of 150 basis points, as it sought to give a boost to the economy. It will next review policy on October 28.
"We don't foresee any reductions in rates," Piti said. "It's hard to imagine a cut unless there's a big shock hit, because 1 per cent is low historically. We've never been at 1 per cent outside of crisis times." 
He added: "Definitely, I think at some point we will have to normalise interest rates when the economy is ready."

items.title: フーシ派、サウジへの攻撃継続を表明　アラムコ本社に大きな被害
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Timour Azhari　Jana Choukeir　Tala Ramadan

[リヤド １４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Timour Azhari　Jana Choukeir　Tala Ramadan

[リヤド １４日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は１４日、サウジアラビアの空港や石油施設への攻撃を続けると表明した。

また石油大手サウジアラムコの本社を攻撃したと発表した。攻撃の実施時期は明らかにしなかった。アラムコの本社は１３日に攻撃を受けていた。 

関係筋によると、攻撃で本社では１４日未明まで火災が続き、複数階で大きな被害を受けた。業務は通常通り続いているが、一部の従業員には在宅勤務を指示、一部の機能が海外拠点に移されたという。

フーシ派はサウジ東部ダーランにあるアラムコの施設、首都リヤドのキング・ハリド国際空港、リヤドのアラムコ製油所に向けて弾道ミサイルや巡航ミサイル、無人機（ドローン）を発射したと説明した。

サウジ主導の連合軍は１４日、フーシ派がリヤドに向けて発射した弾道ミサイル１発を迎撃したと発表した。リヤドでは大きな音が数回聞こえた。

目撃者によると、サウジ当局は同日、これに先立ちリヤドで空からの攻撃の恐れがあるとして警報を出し、その後解除した。音の原因は分かっておらず、当局からの説明はない。

サウジのエネルギー省は、１３日のアラムコ本社への攻撃で小規模な火災が発生したが、死傷者はいなかったと発表した。

items.title: Eutelsat shares jump as Ukraine flags curbs on Starlink military-grade service
items.author: Gianluca Lo Nostro, Hugo Lhomedet
items.creator: Gianluca Lo Nostro, Hugo Lhomedet
items.summary: Shares in European satellite operator Eutelsat soared on Wednesday after Ukraine said SpaceX's Starlink had introduced restrictions on its military-grade service, fuelling investor bets that European providers could benefit from growing strains between Washington and Kyiv.
items.body:
Shares in European satellite operator Eutelsat (ETL.PA) soared on Wednesday after Ukraine said SpaceX's (SPCX.O) Starlink [USN:L1N46007X TEXT:"had introduced restrictions"] on its military-grade service, fuelling investor bets that European providers could benefit from growing strains between Washington and Kyiv.
Eutelsat, which is seen as Europe's best shot at taking on Starlink, surged 23% by 1355 GMT, the stock's biggest one-day gain in 16 months. Luxembourg-based rival SES , which also provides satellite connectivity services, rose 2.6%.
Analysts said the move reflected investor expectations that European governments and customers could seek alternatives to US-owned space assets if access to American services becomes less certain.
"I think this is related to the US administration's favourable Russia/unfavourable Ukraine stance that has developed in recent days, meaning no or limited access to US-owned satellite services and intelligence sharing, putting European providers back in the spotlight as potential alternatives," Bernstein analyst Aleksander Peterc said.
Eutelsat is currently the only other company in the world besides SpaceX that provides space-based internet services through its OneWeb network of satellites in low Earth orbit. But Starlink, which targets consumers directly, has around 10,000 satellites in orbit compared with Eutelsat's more than 600.
Investors appear to be betting that geopolitical tensions could drive demand towards European satellite operators. Experts caution, however, that existing Starlink users cannot simply migrate to OneWeb and that any transition would require the deployment of new terminals and supporting infrastructure.
"OneWeb may provide useful complementary capacity, but considering it as a straightforward substitute overlooks significant operational and infrastructure constraints," independent satellite consultant Christian Freiherr von der Ropp said.
Replacing Starlink or Starshield would require the deployment of large numbers of new user terminals, he said, while adding OneWeb's smaller constellation and different network architecture could limit its usefulness in some military applications.

items.title: Crudo sube por ataques en Arabia Saudita y nuevas tácticas de Irán para atacar tanqueros
items.author: Nicole Jao
items.creator: Nicole Jao
items.summary: El petróleo subía el miércoles, tras un ataque de los hutíes contra Saudi Aramco y luego de que Irán anunciara que está aplicando nuevas tácticas para atacar buques con el objetivo de mantener altos los precios.
items.body:
El petróleo subía el miércoles, tras un ataque de los hutíes contra Saudi Aramco y luego de que Irán anunciara que está aplicando nuevas tácticas para atacar buques con el objetivo de mantener altos los precios.
* A las 1725 GMT, los futuros del Brent subían 87 centavos, o un 0,82%, a 106,56 dólares el barril, y los del West Texas Intermediate en Estados Unidos (WTI) ganaban 1,46 dólares, o un 1,55%, a 95,60 dólares, tocando un pico de tres semanas.
* "Los ataques a buques que cruzan el estrecho de Ormuz y los ataques militares entre Arabia Saudita y los hutíes están respaldando los precios, ya que los actores del mercado siguen preocupados por la disminución de las exportaciones petroleras en la región", afirmó Giovanni Staunovo, analista de UBS.
* Las autoridades iraníes se negaron a dar detalles sobre la nueva estrategia para atacar a los buques, pero una de ellas afirmó que Teherán había comenzado a emplear diferentes tácticas ofensivas hace unos 10 días.
* "El hecho de que las autoridades iraníes admitan abiertamente que están socavando los esfuerzos de Estados Unidos por mantener los precios del petróleo bajo control dice mucho de las verdaderas intenciones que se esconden tras las llamadas 'conversaciones de paz'", señaló Priyanka Sachdeva, de Phillip Nova.
Los flujos de petróleo del Golfo, excluido Irán, se dispararon en septiembre hasta superar el 81% de los niveles previos a la guerra, según datos, impulsados por la recuperación de las exportaciones sauditas. Las exportaciones iraníes cayeron a cero debido al bloqueo estadounidense.
"Que llegue más crudo a los mercados internacionales no significa necesariamente que se esté produciendo más petróleo", señaló en una nota Ole Hansen, analista de Saxo Bank. "Parte de la recuperación refleja una redistribución de los barriles disponibles, incluidos los volúmenes que, de otro modo, habrían abastecido a las refinerías regionales".
* Los hutíes atacaron un edificio administrativo perteneciente a la petrolera estatal Saudi Aramco (2222.SE) en la ciudad de Dhahran, lo que provocó un incendio de alcance limitado, informó el miércoles el Ministerio de Energía saudí.
* El grupo ha lanzado misiles balísticos y drones contra Arabia Saudita durante la última semana en represalia por el apoyo del reino a las fuerzas gubernamentales yemeníes. El aeropuerto internacional de Riad ha sido alcanzado en cuatro ocasiones, y un ataque perpetrado el sábado causó la muerte de 13 personas.
* Por otra parte, un buque portacontenedores se hundió en el sur del estrecho de Ormuz tras chocar contra una mina naval y prenderse fuego, informó la Marina de la Guardia Revolucionaria de Irán.
* Un día antes, el Centro de Operaciones de Comercio Marítimo de Reino Unido informó que un portacontenedores y un petrolero habían sido alcanzados por proyectiles de origen desconocido en el estrecho.

items.title: BofA misses profit estimates on trading weakness, books $1.2 billion charge
items.author: Arasu Basil, Saeed Azhar
items.creator: Arasu Basil, Saeed Azhar
items.summary: Bank of America missed third-quarter profit estimates on Wednesday due to weakness in its trading business and disclosed a $1.2 billion charge tied to a regulatory penalty over failures to detect potential money-laundering activity.
items.body:
Bank of America (BAC.N) missed third-quarter profit estimates on Wednesday due to weakness in its trading business and disclosed a $1.2 billion charge tied to a regulatory penalty over failures to detect potential money-laundering activity.
Shares of the second-biggest US lender fell more than 8%, hitting their lowest price since May.
The Wall Street giant posted weaker fixed income, currency and commodities revenue, mirroring third-quarter trends at rivals [USN:L4N45Z10B TEXT:"JPMorgan Chase"] (JPM.N) , [USN:L4N45Z0VX TEXT:"Wells Fargo"] (WFC.N) and [USN:L4N45Z111 TEXT:"Goldman Sachs"] (GS.N) .
"The poor capital markets performance doubles the negative impact of the earnings miss," Zacks Investment Management Chief Market Strategist Brian Mulberry said.
BofA's sales and trading revenue fell 5% to $5.1 billion in the quarter, as weakness in FICC overshadowed record quarterly equities trading. The bank had last month projected quarterly sales and trading revenue to be relatively flat compared to last year.
Bank of America also showed unrealized losses on its bond portfolio - mortgage backed securities and U.S. Treasury, government-agency bonds - at $109 billion in the quarter ended September, up from $85 billion at the end of June, as bond yields rose in the last quarter.
Bulk of these securities were in held-to-maturity segment, which the bank does not intend to sell.
Banks use the held-to-maturity designation to buy less risky securities that give them downside protection, even though in a rising interest rate environment there is limited upside potential.
"Reduced client activity and changing market conditions, including a major shift in interest rates, significantly affected our leading FICC businesses, including credit mortgages and municipals," Chief Financial Officer Alastair Borthwick said.
Rival JPMorgan on Tuesday also [USN:L4N45Z10B TEXT:"fell short"] of quarterly profit estimates as dealmaking, bond trading momentum slowed down.
Asked how much longer he plans on remaining BofA's CEO, Brian Moynihan said succession is the board's decision.
Moynihan has been at the helm of the storied US bank since 2010 and is one of the longest-serving CEOs of a major US bank.
REGULATORY SETTLEMENT CHARGE The fine, [USN:L6N45Z18I TEXT:"unveiled late Tuesday"], stems from BofA's failure to report over $5 billion in suspicious activity to the US government.
The actions, which include the third-largest penalty in US Treasury history, highlight [USN:L6N45U1B5 TEXT:"growing regulatory scrutiny"] of shortcomings in tackling money laundering at US financial giants.
"There's no asset cap here. It won't crowd out anything," Borthwick told analysts.
Regulators have placed BofA under a consent order — a major regulatory punishment — that requires the bank to work with a third party to identify and report suspicious transactions that went undetected.
BofA had been working with regulators for some time to reach the resolutions, Borthwick said, adding the bank had added thousands of people to shore up its efforts to tackle money laundering.
The Charlotte, North Carolina-based bank reported a profit of $6.9 billion, or 91 cents per share, for the three months ended September 30, compared with $8.3 billion, or $1.04 per share, a year earlier.
Excluding the $1.2 billion regulatory settlement charge, BofA earned $1.08 per share, missing estimates of $1.10 per share, according to estimates compiled by LSEG.
Wall Street analysts said the penalty would likely add to negative sentiment and raise concerns about expenses and the duration of the order.
The penalty follows a 2024 consent order from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, which had required BofA to address shortcomings in its ability to police money laundering.
Since late 2023, BofA has been working with US regulators to overhaul its safeguards against money laundering and other illegal transactions.
NII SHINES AS DEALMAKING WEAKENS BofA's investment banking fees fell 11% to $1.8 billion in the quarter. The bank had last month projected a decline of at least 10%, as it wasn't well positioned in some businesses that saw more activity.
Dealmaking also slowed in the reported quarter as a grinding bond market rout and equities volatility weighed on activity.
"There's a period in volatility like that where buyers and sellers just need to readjust valuations and expectations. So that always happens," Borthwick said, referring to the move in interest rates.
Investment banking fees can be lumpy from quarter-to-quarter and are influenced by when deals close. Transaction timing can often move around due to market conditions and regulatory approvals.
"The environment for deal making remains solid. It's a pretty active environment," Borthwick said, adding that BofA's investment banking pipelines are strong.
BofA slipped to fourth place in the global investment banking league table for the first nine months of 2026, from third in the same period a year earlier, Dealogic data showed.
In a bright spot, net interest income (NII) — the difference between what a bank earns on loans and pays out on deposits — jumped 8% in the quarter, driven by higher loan and deposit balances and fixed-rate asset repricing.
BofA expects interest income to improve sequentially in the fourth-quarter. Full-year NII growth is anticipated to be 8% or more in 2027.

BANGKOK, Oct 14 : Japan's top currency diplomat Atsushi Mimura said on Wednesday the investment activities of the country's Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) are supporting the "function and liquidity" of global financial markets.
Japan had responded quite early to the challenges of a rapidly ageing population through measures such as introducing universal pensions and healthcare systems in 1961, Mimura said in a panel on demographics and ageing population held during the IMF meetings in Bangkok.
Such steps created positive side effects, such as a "very healthy" workforce and a dramatic accumulation of pension funds, he said, with the GPIF now the world's biggest institutional investor.
"In this way, the proactive and early introduction of policies not only supported us in responding, or better responding, to population ageing, but also gave us a lot of positive by-products," said Mimura, who is Japan's vice finance minister for international affairs.
GPIF reported a record quarterly investment gain in the April-June quarter, heightening attention on whether the world's largest pension fund should rethink its investment strategy. Any shift in its portfolio strategy would reverberate across global financial markets, analysts say.

items.title: 米ブラックロック、第3四半期は増益　運用手数料収入拡大
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１４日 ロイター] - 世界最大の資産運用会社、米ブラックロックが１４日発表した第３・四半期（７─９月）決算は、運用資産が増加し増益となった。顧客資金の運用で得る手数料収入が増えた。

同社株は取引開始前の時間外取引で３．１％上昇した。

純利益は１６億６０００万ドル（１株当たり１０．５７ドル）。前年同期は１３億２０００万ドル（同８．４３ドル）。

運用資産残高は前年同期の１３兆４６００億ドルから１５兆４９００億ドルに増えた。

主力のｉシェアーズ上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）に１３４５億ドルの新規資金が流入したことに加え、堅調な株式市場を背景に保有資産の評価額が上昇したことが寄与した。

ラリー・フィンク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は声明で「市場のファンダメンタルズは強固で十分な支えがある。新技術が利益率の上昇と利益成長の勢いを後押ししている」と述べた。

資産運用会社は今年、通商政策の変化やイラン紛争に伴う市場の変動への対応を迫られてきた。ただ、米国株式市場は人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の上昇に支えられ、底堅さを保ってきた。主要株価指数のＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種指数は第３・四半期を通じて上昇を続け、最高値圏にある。

第３・四半期の債券商品への純流入額はに７８２億ドルとなった。足元の米国債の急落にもかかわらず、投資家の需要が強いことを示した。

＜プライベート市場への進出を加速＞

ブラックロックは近年、プライベートクレジット市場への進出を加速させている。主な収益源であるＥＴＦよりも手数料が高い。ＥＴＦで収益を伸ばすには多額の資金流入が必要となる。

同社は２０２０年代末までに売上高を３５０億ドル超とし、その３０％超をプライベート市場とテクノロジー事業で稼ぐ計画を示している。

プライベートクレジット業界に対しては、人工知能（ＡＩ）による事業への打撃を特に受けやすいとされるソフトウエア企業への融資状況や、プライベート市場の資産評価の不透明さに対する懸念から、投資家の厳しい目が向けられている。

こうした懸念を背景に、ここ数四半期は投資家からの解約請求が急増した。ただ、積み上がった解約請求は解消に向かいつつあるようだ。プライベートクレジットファンドを運用する大手の大半が、第３・四半期に解約請求の減速を報告している。

ブラックロック傘下のＨＰＳコーポレート・レンディング・ファンドでは、解約請求の対象となった持ち分の割合が、第２・四半期の１３．３％から直近の四半期には約１１．５％に低下した。

ブラックロックはプライベート市場事業の売上高を個別に開示していないが、同分野への第３・四半期の純流入額は１５３億１０００万ドルだった。

items.title: 米ロ軽油合意「極めて危険」、対ロ制裁弱めると伊首相
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Giuseppe Fonte

[ローマ １４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Giuseppe Fonte

[ローマ １４日 ロイター] - イタリアのメローニ首相は１４日、米国とロシアの間で結ばれたディーゼル油（軽油）供給合意について、ロシアのプーチン大統領をウクライナとの交渉の場に着かせようとする取り組みに逆行する「極めて危険な選択」だと批判した。

トランプ米大統領は、燃料価格高騰を受け、９日にロシアのプーチン大統領と電話会談を行い、ロシアが米国と世界市場にディーゼル（軽油）を供給することで合意した。

メローニ氏は議会で演説し、「この合意は、結果が不透明である一方、リスクは明白だ」と述べた。「ウクライナの各都市に爆弾が投下され続けている中でロシア政府に正当性を与え、戦争資金となる新たな収入をもたらし、制裁の実効性を弱めることになる」と指摘した。

ＥＵ加盟国がロシア・ウクライナ戦争を巡って欧州を代表して交渉を行う「権威ある人物」を任命すべきだとし、ドイツ、フランス、英国の３カ国（Ｅ３）に公式な交渉権限を与える可能性も排除しなかった。

「もしフランス、ドイツ、英国が、われわれ全員で行うよりも自分たちだけで行う方がうまくやれると考え、そういう選択をしてきたのであれば、少なくとも全員を代表して公式な権限を持ってそうさせるべきだ」と述べた。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）は今週、首脳会議を開催する。メローニ氏は、対ウクライナ支援弱体化を狙ったロシアによるドローン（無人機）による領空侵犯やサイバー攻撃、破壊工作などの秘密工作に言及し、首脳会議で激化しているロシアのハイブリッド攻撃について協議するとの見通しを示した。

「われわれはエネルギー網、海底ケーブル、港湾、空港、そしてイタリアが優れた知見を有する海底領域など、重要インフラを保護する必要がある」と語った。

items.title: 中国新規銀行融資、9月は1兆0800億元に急増　予想上回る
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kevin Yao　Shi Bu

[北京 １４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Kevin Yao　Shi Bu

[北京 １４日 ロイター] - 中国の９月の新規銀行融資は１兆０８００億元（１６１３億７０００万ドル）となった。市場予想を上回り、低調だった８月の６００億元から大幅に増加した。人民銀行（中央銀行）が１４日発表したデータに基づきロイターが算出した。

ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想は９７５０億元、前年同月は１兆２９００億元だった。中国の銀行は通常、内部目標の達成に向け、四半期末にかけて融資を加速させる。

中国政府は９月下旬、対象を絞った利下げや住宅ローン補助などの成長促進策を打ち出した。融資の回復は、政府による最新の景気刺激策が効果を上げ始めている可能性を示している。ただ信用全体の伸びは弱く、家計と企業の資金需要は依然として鈍いとみられる。

国泰君安国際のチーフエコノミスト周浩氏は「改善は９月に新たな政策金融手段が導入され、プロジェクト投資や企業の資金需要を支えたことを反映している可能性が高い」と述べた。「好調な貿易統計と合わせ、今回の数字は既存の政策措置が経済活動に好影響を及ぼしていることを示唆している」と分析した。

ロイターの算出によると、住宅ローンを含む家計向け融資は９月は横ばいだった。８月は２０２９億元の減少だった。企業向け融資は８月の２６００億元から１兆２９００億元に急増した。 

９月の人民元建て融資残高は前年同月比４．８％増と、過去最低の伸びとなった。８月の４．９％増から鈍化したが、アナリスト予想とは一致した。

１─９月の新規融資は計１１兆５２００億元と、前年同期の１４兆７５００億元から減少した。

キャピタル・エコノミクスはリポートで「信用全体の弱さが追加金融緩和につながるとは考えにくい。とりわけ人民銀はその弱さの多くを構造的な問題とみているからだ」と指摘した。「ただ経済全体が抱える多額の債務負担と企業部門の資金繰りの悪化を踏まえると、人民銀には来年、金融緩和の再開を求める圧力がかかると予想する。われわれは計０．２０％ポイントの利下げを見込んでいる」とした。

９月の広義のマネーサプライ（Ｍ２）は前年同月比７．２％増と、１８カ月ぶりの低い伸びにとどまった。ロイター調査によるアナリスト予想の７．４％増も下回った。８月は７．５％増だった。

狭義のマネーサプライ（Ｍ１）は前年比３．２％増と、８月の４．１％増から伸びが鈍化した。

信用と流動性を示す広範な指標である社会融資総量の残高は前年比７．１％増と、８月の７．２％増から減速した。政府債の発行が加速すれば、社会融資総量は押し上げられる可能性がある。

items.title: Oro baja más de 1% por mayores apuestas de alza tasas Fed tras datos inflación EEUU
items.author: Vishak Mathew
items.creator: Vishak Mathew
items.summary: El oro bajó más de un 1% el miércoles, sumando su tercera ronda de descensos seguida, ya que unos datos de inflación superiores a lo esperado aumentaron las expectativas de que la Reserva Federal suba las tasas de interés este mes.
items.body:
El oro bajó más de un 1% el miércoles, sumando su tercera ronda de descensos seguida, ya que unos datos de inflación superiores a lo esperado aumentaron las expectativas de que la Reserva Federal suba las tasas de interés este mes.
* A las 1805 GMT, el oro al contado cedía un 1,8% a 4.083,94 dólares por onza, su menor nivel desde el 7 de octubre, mientras que los futuros del oro en Estados Unidos para entrega en diciembre bajaron un 1,7% a 4.107,90 dólares.
* El índice dólar (.DXY) subía un 0,5%, encareciendo el oro denominado en esa moneda para los tenedores de otras divisas, mientras que los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a 10 años también aumentaron.
* "En este momento, todo apunta a que es más probable que la Fed suba las tasas", afirmó David Meger, director de operaciones con metales de High Ridge Futures, citando los datos del índice de precios al consumo (IPC), más altos de lo esperado, que se han mantenido por encima de los objetivos de la Fed.
* Los precios al consumidor en Estados Unidos se aceleraron en septiembre por un repunte en los precios de la gasolina, en un nuevo revés para el presidente Donald Trump y su Partido Republicano antes de las elecciones legislativas de noviembre.
* El IPC subió un 0,6% el mes pasado, tras registrar un aumento del 0,4% en agosto, informó la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales del Departamento de Trabajo.
* Los mercados estiman que hay un 42% de probabilidades de que la Fed suba las tasas este mes, frente al 22% antes de conocerse los datos de inflación, y descuentan una probabilidad del 93% de que se produzca un alza en diciembre, según la herramienta FedWatch de CME.
* Aunque el oro suele considerarse una cobertura contra la inflación, el aumento de las tasas de interés tiende a reducir el atractivo de este metal precioso, que no devenga intereses.
* El petróleo subía el miércoles, tras un ataque de los hutíes contra Saudi Aramco y luego de que Irán anunciara que está aplicando nuevas tácticas para atacar buques con el objetivo de mantener altos los precios.
* En otros metales preciosos, la plata al contado perdía un 6,6% a 55,53 dólares por onza; el platino restaba un 3,5%, a 1.605,37 dólares; y el paladio cedía un 2,8% a 1.094,50 dólares.

items.title: Ohio's working-class voters rethink support for Trump and the Republican Party
items.author: Richard Cowan
items.creator: Richard Cowan
items.summary: A decade after Republican Donald Trump peeled away working-class and union voters who had long been a cornerstone of Democratic support in Ohio, Democrats and labor leaders see an opening to win back some of them in the November 3 US elections.
items.body:
A decade after Republican Donald Trump peeled away working-class and union voters who had long been a cornerstone of Democratic support in Ohio, Democrats and labor leaders see an opening to win back some of them in the November 3 US elections .
Now midway through his second term, the president's magic appears to be losing at least some of its luster with blue-collar men and women as rising prices, the Iran war and concerns about his rhetoric prompt some voters to reconsider their support.
The state's reputation as a leading swing state began to fade in 2016 when Trump won strong support from working-class voters who felt their economic concerns were being heard, helping turn Ohio into a reliably Republican state.
Almost overnight, Ohio became rock-solid Republican. Ohio voted for the eventual winner in 14 straight presidential elections from 1964 until 2020 when Democrat Joe Biden won nationally but Ohio backed Trump.
A shift in Ohio toward Democrats could matter in elections that will help determine whether Republicans retain control of Congress during Trump's final two years in office or hand new leverage [USN:L6N45U0XV TEXT:"to Democrats"] over his agenda.
The stakes are high in Ohio, where Republicans are defending a US Senate seat and the governor's office. Two House races are rated [USN:L1N45R0LS TEXT:""toss-ups.""] One, in northwestern Ohio, has long been held by a Democrat and the other, in northeastern Ohio, is Republican-held.
Trump is not on the ballot this time but has told supporters to act as if he is. It remains to be seen whether that could end up helping or hindering Republicans running in tough races.
Republican Senator Jon Husted is in a tight competition with Democratic former Senator Sherrod Brown, while Democrat Amy Acton is challenging Republican Vivek Ramaswamy for an open governor's seat.
Trump campaigned with Husted and Ramaswamy in Youngstown on Monday to try to energize the Republican base.
'GOD KNOWS WE DIDN'T VOTE FOR THIS' Paul Ringold, a 48-year-old steel hauler and pastor of the mostly Black congregation at the Shalom Church of God and Christ in the city of Warren, embodies the uncertainty that Democrats hope could help them make inroads with working-class voters.
Ringold voted for Trump for president in 2016, Democrat Joe Biden in 2020 and Trump again in 2024, but said he remains undecided about whom to support for the US Senate, governor and other offices this year.
"I'm in the wilderness trying to find a place," he said.
Ringold said rising fuel and food prices and Trump's combative style have left him questioning some of the choices made by a president he once strongly supported.
"God knows we didn't vote for this," he said of inflation.
Like several voters interviewed by Reuters, Ringold also cited Trump's rhetoric. "I wish he would just tone down that rhetoric ... that old New York in-your-face 'I got you sucker'" persona, he said.
EARLY TURNOUT FAVORS DEMOCRATS In early voting that began in Ohio last week, Democrats appeared to be more motivated than Republicans.
In Trumbull County, home to the city of Warren and many blue-collar jobs, a strong turnout during the first three days brought 1,224 Democrats to the polls, 559 Republicans and 453 with no known political affiliation, according to county data.
Paul Sracic, an Ohio-based senior fellow with the right-of-center Hudson Institute, said "working-class voters, if they are moving at all away from Trump, Brown is a safe landing spot for them" because of the former senator's populist record.
"Trump has done a good job of basically focusing on social issues with our guys," said Jose Arroyo, a United Steelworkers official who engages in contract negotiations and labor relations for the sprawling labor union.
Trump "seemed to latch on sort of to the dissatisfaction of where the working man has gone. Pensions go away. Plants close. Livelihoods they've always known disappear."
The problem, he said, is that focusing primarily on hot-button social issues ignores advancing policies that would "improve the lives of working people" and actually turn them into law.
The 50,000 manufacturing jobs in 1990 in the Youngstown-Warren area fell to about 20,000 in 2026, according to the US Bureau of Labor Statistics.
In recent years, the Mahoning Valley, long a powerhouse of the steel and automotive industries, has attracted a few new manufacturing plants. Arroyo said the Iran war has boosted domestic oil industry exploration, creating more demand for equipment made of steel. But he acknowledged that the war had also brought higher consumer prices.
NLRB 'DISMANTLING' When Trump began his second term in January 2025, he promptly [USN:L2N3OO0LL TEXT:"fired"] two Democratic officials at the National Labor Relations Board and left the agency without the quorum required to take actions. That paralysis lasted [USN:L1N3XM0FP TEXT:"for nearly a year."]
Ohio AFL-CIO President Tim Burga cited what he called Trump's "dismantling" of the NLRB as having hindered union organizing efforts and made it harder to contest unfair labor practices and secure work contracts with companies.
"We were on a path for the first time in my lifetime, under the Biden administration, for having a national industrial policy," Burga said, but the Trump administration rolled much of it back. [USN:L2N3S70NN TEXT:"Biden and Congress enacted programs"] to spur investment in such industries as clean energy and semiconductors.
Trump's trade battles with Canada also were unhelpful to labor, he said.
OHIO VOTERS REMAIN DIVIDED Bill Callahan, 75, a self-described Democrat from Cortland, said some relatives who once backed Trump "are traveling back" toward Democrats because "they don't like (politicians) taking money out of their pockets."
A part-time warehouse worker from Cortland after a career at General Electric, he said he considered voting for Trump in 2016 but was put off by ethical concerns.
Others interviewed by Reuters said higher prices were not enough to change their vote.
Joe Scarabino, who co-owns a bait-and-tackle business with his wife Kathryn near Cortland, said the couple responded to higher fuel costs by raising delivery charges rather than product prices, thus having an impact on fewer customers and small business owners.
"We believe our Christian values are more than gas prices," he said. The couple declined to say who they support.
Retired coal-fired power plant worker Chuck Burns, 67, of Wellsville, credited Trump with reducing illegal immigration and boosting the value of his retirement investments. "He's done a good job ... he's got balls," Burns said.
Burns praised Trump's immigration restrictions at the southern border and said his retirement savings have increased in value since Biden left office.
Asked what issues worry him in this election season, Burns said, "It's just that Democrats – it's unbelievable some of the stuff that they want to do."
Asked to explain, Burns raised transgender issues. "Those poor people, they feel that way, that's fine, that's their business," he said. "They (Democrats) don't need to incorporate our young kids into that stuff."

items.title: Wall Street tumbles as hot inflation data feeds worries about Fed rate hikes
items.author: Noel Randewich, Purvi Agarwal
items.creator: Noel Randewich, Purvi Agarwal
items.summary: Hotter-than-expected inflation data sent Wall Street tumbling on Wednesday, with worries about more interest rate hikes from the Federal Reserve pummeling shares of Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sensitive to higher borrowing costs.
items.body:
Hotter-than-expected inflation data sent Wall Street tumbling on Wednesday, with worries about more interest rate hikes from the Federal Reserve pummeling shares of Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sensitive to higher borrowing costs.
Increased bets that the Fed will have to further hike rates to tame inflation dealt a [USN:L4N4601KQ TEXT:"sharp blow"] to some of the market's biggest gainers of 2026. Oracle (ORCL.N) lost 7.3%, while AI-infrastructure firms CoreWeave (CRWV.O) and Nebius (NBIS.O) tumbled 15% and 10%, respectively.
Dell (DELL.N) dropped 12% and Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE.N) lost 7.6% after Barclays downgraded the AI server makers to "equal-weight" from "overweight".
The Philadelphia SE Semiconductor index (.SOX) dropped almost 4%, down for a sixth straight session and on track for its longest losing streak since May 2025.
US consumer prices [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"accelerated"] in September as the cost of gasoline surged and price pressures broadened beyond energy, data from the Labor Department's Bureau of Labor Statistics showed.
Interest rate traders are pricing in a 37% chance that the Fed will raise rates at its policy meeting this month, up from 22% on Tuesday, according to CME's FedWatch tool.
"Investors are not happy with the report because that puts pressure on the Fed to raise rates to combat inflation," said Adam Sarhan, chief executive of 50 Park Investments, in New York. "Inflation remains public enemy number one for the market and for the Fed."
The S&P 500 was down 1.35% at 7,700.08 points.
The Nasdaq declined 2.02% to 26,654.96 points, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 0.51% at 51,405.02 points.
Eight of the 11 S&P 500 sector indexes declined, led lower by information technology (.SPLRCT) , down 2.64%, followed by a 1.77% loss in communication services (.SPLRCL) .
After hitting a record high last week, the S&P 500 remains up over 12% in 2026, with most of that gain fueled by AI-related stocks. The median S&P 500 stock has gained 4% in 2026, and over 200 of the index's components are in negative territory.
Bank of America (BAC.N) fell 5.8%. The lender's [USN:L4N4600WF TEXT:"profit fell"] in the third quarter as it set aside $1.2 billion to cover regulatory fines for failures to detect potential money laundering. Morgan Stanley (MS.N) dropped 3.8%, despite a [USN:L4N4600Y8 TEXT:"rise in quarterly profit"].
The S&P 500 Banks index (.SPXBK) was last down 1.2%. Earlier, it dipped more than 2% to its lowest level in over four months.
Asset manager BlackRock (BLK.N) was near flat after reporting a jump in[USN:L4N4600US TEXT:" third-quarter profit"].
The Fed has time to wait and see how markets and the economy evolve after its September rate rise before deciding further action, Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman said.
Bending Spoons (BSP.O) rallied 45% after Berkshire Hathaway (BRKa.N) invested another [USN:L4N4601HL TEXT:"$330 million"] in the owner of Vimeo and AOL, a big endorsement from the high-profile investor whose moves traders closely follow.
Declining stocks outnumbered rising ones within the S&P 500 (.AD.SPX) by a 1.7-to-one ratio.
The S&P 500 posted 14 new highs and 11 new lows; the Nasdaq recorded 22 new highs and 466 new lows.

items.title: BHP, Escondida supervisors reach deal to avert strike at Chile copper mine
items.author: Fabian Cambero
items.creator: Fabian Cambero
items.summary: BHP and the supervisors' union at its Escondida mine in Chile have struck a deal over improved compensation and benefits, avoiding a strike at the world's largest copper mine, both parties said on Wednesday.
items.body:
BHP (BHP.AX) and the supervisors' union at its Escondida mine in Chile have struck a deal over improved compensation and benefits, avoiding a strike at the world's largest copper mine, both parties said on Wednesday.
The threat of a stoppage at Escondida had helped support copper prices and, along with low LME copper inventories, fuelled supply concerns for the metal widely used in the power, construction and manufacturing sectors.
The union said in a statement announcing the deal that 64% of its members had accepted the company's proposal while 35% refused.
"The offer presented today is approved by the union, thus concluding the 2026 regulated collective bargaining process," it added.
BHP said that the new contract is valid for 36 months and includes improvements in fixed and variable compensation and current benefits, also incorporating new bonuses and other benefits.
Two sources familiar with the talks had earlier [USN:L6N4600KA TEXT:"told Reuters"] that negotiators struck a tentative deal after the company improved its offer.
"The parties reached a pre-agreement that includes improved benefits and better closing terms than the offer presented by the company on October 12," the union had said in an earlier statement.
BHP's previous offer included final payments and a low-interest loan package worth about $30,000 per worker.
The talks began [USN:L6N45Z1D0 TEXT:"hours earlier on Tuesday"] in a last-minute push to avoid a walkout that risked disrupting supply from a mine central to the global copper market.
The union had warned it was prepared to strike as early as Wednesday if mediation failed to produce a new collective labor agreement.

items.title: 簗農相が辞任、高市首相「任命責任重く受け止める」　予算カット発言に批判
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tamiyuki Kihara

[東京 １４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Tamiyuki Kihara

[東京 １４日 ロイター] - 簗和生農林水産相（自民党衆院議員、比例北関東ブロック）が１４日、辞任した。道路予算の削減発言などをめぐって与野党から批判が高まる中、消費税減税法案の国会審議への影響が懸念されていた。高市氏は記者団に「任命責任を重く受け止めている」と語った。

簗氏は同日夕に首相官邸を訪れて辞表を提出した。受理した高市氏は記者団に、「首相として国会審議、農林水産行政に集中できない状況が続くことは看過できない」と理由を説明した。後任の農水相は「明日（１５日）お伝えする」とも語った。

高市氏は、辞任はあくまで簗氏の意向によるものだと強調し、更迭との見方を否定。自身の任命責任に何度か言及する一方、「今後、消費税・支援金法案、中東情勢への対応、責任ある積極財政を実現するための予算編成など重要な課題に一つひとつ答えを出していく」とし、改めて政策実現に注力する考えを示した。

これに先立ち、簗氏は官邸で記者団に「国会審議で迷惑をこれ以上かけるわけにもいかないし、農林水産行政に集中できない状況がこれ以上続くということは避けなければいけない」と説明。「自ら決断をした」と語った。  

高市氏は一度は簗氏を続投させる方針を示したものの、地元自治体への「予算カット」発言に加え、公職選挙法違反の疑惑が浮上したことなどから、辞任の必要性について検討していた。

簗氏は大臣就任前の５月、栃木県内で開かれた党支部の懇親会で、２月の衆院選で首長が対立候補を支援した那須烏山市と那珂川町について、２０２６年度の道路予算を「大幅にカットした」などと発言。与野党から、国会議員による地方自治体への圧力だとの批判や、行政の公平性を疑問視する声が噴出した。

簗氏は国土交通省への働きかけを否定し、１０月５日に発言を撤回して謝罪した。国交省は６日、簗氏から２市町への予算配分について照会があったと認める一方、働きかけや圧力はなかったとの認識を示していた。ただ、自民内からも「有権者に対して懲罰的に予算をカットしたと声高に言うなど、あり得ない感覚だ」（政務三役経験者）との声が出ていた。

また、過去２回の衆院選の公示日に、支持者をシャトルバスで出陣式会場に無料送迎していたことも判明。週刊文春は１４日、簗氏側が選挙運動員に報酬を支払っていたとも報じた。いずれも公職選挙法違反に当たる可能性がある。

簗氏は１４日午前の衆院予算委員会で自身の進退を問われ、「全力で職責を全うしたい」と述べた。高市氏は簗氏の処遇について「（言動の）違法性が大いに疑われ、私も法令違反ではないかという判断に至った時は、人事上のこともちゅうちょしない」と述べていた。

野党は今後、高市氏の任命責任を問う構えで、政権への打撃は避けられない。内閣支持率に影響する可能性もある。

簗氏の選挙区は栃木３区。衆院選では小選挙区で敗れ、比例復活した。９月１７日の内閣改造で初入閣していた。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [モスクワ １４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ １４日 ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）は１４日、ロシアの９月の原油生産量が前月比日量６万５０００バレル増の８４３万バレルになったと発表した。ただ前年同月の水準をなお約８７万バレル下回っている。

最近発表されたロシアの軽油輸出規制の緩和について、同国で稼働可能な製油所の処理能力が不足しているため、世界の軽油需給に大きな変化をもたらす可能性は低いとの見方を示した。

ＩＥＡによると、ロシアの９月の原油輸出量は前月比日量６万バレル増の５３０万バレルとなった。一方、ウクライナの攻撃による精製操業への支障が続き、製油所の推定原油処理量は２カ月連続で横ばいだった。

カザフスタンの９月の原油生産量は日量１９０万バレルと、ほぼ横ばいだった。

カザフの原油・コンデンセート輸出量は全ルートの合計で、前月比日量４万バレル減の１８０万バレルとなった。

石油輸出国機構（ＯＰＥＣ）は１３日、ロシアの９月の原油生産量が前月比日量３万８０００バレル減の８６４万３０００バレルと、一段と落ち込んだと発表した。

items.title: Supervisores de mina chilena Escondida de BHP evitan huelga y aceptan nuevo contrato
items.author: Fabián Andrés Cambero
items.creator: Fabián Andrés Cambero
items.summary: Los supervisores de la mina chilena Escondida, controlada por BHP, aprobaron el miércoles un nuevo contrato colectivo de 36 meses, lo que evitó una huelga en el mayor yacimiento global de cobre.
items.body:
Los supervisores de la mina chilena Escondida, controlada por BHP, aprobaron el miércoles un nuevo contrato colectivo de 36 meses, lo que evitó una huelga en el mayor yacimiento global de cobre.
Dos fuentes con conocimiento de las negociaciones informaron a Reuters en la madrugada del preacuerdo entre el gremio y la empresa, y que la propuesta ya redactada se presentaría a los socios del gremio para su ratificación.
Tras el conteo, la propuesta tuvo una aprobación del 64,14% de los votos válidos frente a un rechazo del 35,85%.
"La oferta presentada el día de hoy se entiende por aprobada por la base sindical y con esto ha finalizado el proceso de negociación colectiva reglada", dijo el sindicato en un boletín a sus socios.
La noche del martes el sindicato había anunciado [USN:L6N45Z1D4 TEXT:"un fracaso de las negociaciones y el inicio de la paralización"] en el primer turno del miércoles, pero después fueron citados nuevamente por el mediador a una nueva reunión que se extendió durante toda la noche y culminó con la redacción del nuevo instrumento colectivo.
El gremio detalló en un comunicado más temprano que se realizaría la votación online para avalar el resultado obtenido.
BHP confirmó que las partes ya firmaron el acuerdo, con lo que quedó cerrada la negociación.
"El nuevo contrato tiene una vigencia de 36 meses y contiene mejoras significativas en compensaciones fijas, variables y beneficios actuales, incorporando además nuevos bonos y otros beneficios. De esta manera, los Supervisores y Staff siguen contando con un contrato líder en la industria para el segmento", dijo la empresa en un comunicado.
Previamente, BHP había informado que Escondida continuaba operando con normalidad.
El temor de un huelga en Escondida y la paralización desde la semana pasada de la mina Centinela de Antofagasta Minerals han dado soporte a los precios globales del cobre en momentos en que la industria atraviesa dificultades para impulsar la oferta.
La propuesta contempla pagos finales y préstamo blando por unos 30.500 dólares por socio.
Escondida, enclavada en el norteño desierto de Atacama, es operada por BHP, pero está asociada con la global Rio Tinto y la japonesa JECO.

items.body:
Yuliia Dysa　Dan Peleschuk

[キーウ／ロンドン　１４日 ロイター] - ウクライナは１４日、米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いるスペースＸが衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の利用を制限したと明らかにした。スターリンクが欠かせないドローン（無人機）を利用した戦闘任務のほか、防空活動などに支障が出ているという。米国とウクイライナの関係が急速に冷え込む中、トランプ氏の有力な同盟者であるマスク氏の企業がウクライナ軍の能力を制限している可能性が浮上したことで、米国が圧力を加えて譲歩を迫るのではないかとの懸念がウクライナで高まっている。

英国を訪問中のウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は「スターリンクや情報共有を巡り、いくつかの問題が生じているのは残念だ。真のパートナーシップがあれば予想できないような様々な事態が起きている」と述べ、米国との関係を巡る最近の展開に驚いているとの認識を表明。「ウクライナは米国とのパートナーシップを頼りにしている」とし、「ウクライナは誠実、かつ率直で、強力なパートナーでありたい」と語った。

ウクライナ軍当局者によると、スペースＸは事前通告なしに、高速で移動する際の軍用スターリンク端末の機能を停止した。ウクライナは多くのドローンにスターリンク受信機を搭載し、誘導システムの一部として活用しており、ロシア支配地域を含むウクライナ全土で利用されている。

ウクライナのベスクレストノフ大統領顧問は「ウクライナの防衛部隊はこうした制限について事前通知を受けておらず、その結果、複数の任務が妨げられた」と通信アプリ「テレグラム」に投稿した。

ベスクレストノフ氏によると、スペースＸは時速１６０キロの速度制限を導入。ウクライナ国防省筋はロイターに対し、一部部隊からはこの半分にも達しない速度で誘導システムの通信が切断されたとの報告が寄せられていると明らかにした。こうした速度制限により、ウクライナ国内にあるロシア軍目標への攻撃のほか、ロシア軍のドローンに対する防空活動などが妨げられているという。

この件に関してスペースＸからコメントは得られていない。ウクライナ国防省筋によると、今回の突然の制限について説明を求めるため、ウクライナ政府はスペースＸのほか、米政府、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）と協議している。

ロシアはこの日もウクライナ各地に対するミサイルやドローンによる攻撃を続け、大規模な停電が発生するなど被害が広がった。ロイターなどはこれまで、米国はウクライナに対しロシアの石油精製施設への攻撃停止を求める圧力の一環として、ミサイル攻撃の早期警戒に関する情報提供を停止する可能性を示唆していると報じている。

items.summary: India and Russia on Wednesday held the seventh round of talks under the India-Russia Special Mechanism on Pakistan and Afghanistan in New Delhi, reaffirming their commitment to strengthening bilateral ...
items.body:
India, Russia hold 7th round of 'Special Mechanism' talks on Pakistan and Afghanistan India and Russia on Wednesday held the seventh round of talks under the India-Russia Special Mechanism on Pakistan and Afghanistan in New Delhi, reaffirming their commitment to strengthening bilateral cooperation under their Special and Privileged Strategic Partnership.
ANI | Updated: 14-10-2026 21:36 IST | Created: 14-10-2026 21:36 IST

Deputy National Security Adviser Pavan Kapoor, Russia’s Deputy Secretary of Security Council Aleksandr Venediktov (Photo/X/@MEAIndia). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

India and Russia on Wednesday held the seventh round of talks under the India-Russia Special Mechanism on Pakistan and Afghanistan in New Delhi, reaffirming their commitment to strengthening bilateral cooperation under their Special and Privileged Strategic Partnership. Ministry of External Affairs in a press release said that the talks were co-chaired by India's Deputy National Security Adviser Pavan Kapoor and Russia's Deputy Secretary of the Security Council Aleksandr Venediktov.
According to the press release, the two sides held wide-ranging discussions on issues of common interest, including their implications for international security. “Both sides held wide-ranging discussions on issues of common interest, including their impact on international security. They reaffirmed their commitment to strengthen their ongoing cooperation under the aegis of ‘India-Russia Special and Privileged Strategic Partnership’,” the press release stated.
During his visit to New Delhi, Venediktov also called on National Security Adviser Ajit Doval, the Ministry said. The latest round of talks comes amid continued engagement between New Delhi and Moscow on regional security and broader strategic issues.
Earlier on Wednesday, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar described India as a “natural option” for Russia as Moscow increasingly turns towards Asia amid strained relations with Europe. Speaking in a conversation with John Micklethwait, Editor-in-Chief of the Bloomberg New Economy Forum, Jaishankar said Russia's relationship with Europe had deteriorated following the Russia-Ukraine war, prompting Moscow to strengthen its engagement with Asian countries.
He emphasised that India-Russia relations had remained steady over the past 75-80 years and that maintaining these ties served the interests of both countries. “We are a natural option in that regard because we've had very decent relations with Russia from pretty much the early start,” Jaishankar said, adding that India wanted Russia to maintain meaningful relationships across Asia.
The External Affairs Minister also highlighted the strategic significance of the partnership, stating that it had contributed to the balance of power and the overall status quo in Asia. (ANI)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [上海 １４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[上海 １４日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は下落し１年超ぶりの安値で引けた。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連サプライチェーン銘柄が売られた。

ＣＳＩ３００指数は終盤に２０２５年８月以来の安値を付け、１．４％安で終了。上海総合指数は０．９％安。

香港のハンセン指数は０．１％安。大手テック株は０．９％上昇したが、依然２年ぶりの安値付近にとどまっている。

中国の９月の生産者物価指数（ＰＰＩ）は４年超ぶりの高い伸びとなった一方、消費者物価は市場予想を下回る伸びにとどまった。原油やコモディティー（商品）価格の高騰が、上流部門の価格を押し上げた一方、国内需要の弱さが幅広い物価圧力を抑制した。

原油高を背景にＣＳＩエネルギー指数は約２％上昇した。

生活必需品株は０．３％高。

ＡＩサプライチェーン関連銘柄は後場に一段安。５Ｇ通信指数は３．８％下落。上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け株式市場｢科創板」の科創板５０指数は３．３％安となった。

中国の株価指数は、政府の大規模景気刺激策を受けて急伸した２年前の水準に近づいている。ＨＳＢＣのアナリストは、上海総合、ＣＳＩ３００、深セン総合各指数の２０２６年末目標を９─１５％引き下げ、それぞれ４１００、４８００、１万４５００とした。現在の水準から８─１５％の上昇余地があることを意味する。

ＨＳＢＣは、バリュー株は７月以降グロース株をアウトパフォームしているが、グロース株のバリュエーションの低さや利益見通しの上方修正の勢いの強さを理由に、この傾向は一時的なものにとどまる可能性があると指摘した。

items.title: ＬＳＥＧ、エヌビディアと提携　過去の市場データ分析を高速化
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１４日 ロイター] - ＬＳＥＧ（ロンドン証券取引所グループ）は１４日、米半導体大手エヌビディアと提携したと発表した。エヌビディアの技術を活用し、金融機関が大量の過去の市場データをより高速かつ大規模に処理・分析できるよう支援する。

ＬＳＥＧによると、エヌビディアの専用プロセッサーを使えば、元のデータを複製せずにそのまま処理し、全ての取引と気配値を数秒で調べて分析結果を得られる可能性が示された。株式取引の２４時間化が進む中、調査をより速く、リアルタイムに近い形で行えるようになるという。

ＬＳＥＧのデータ・分析部門の共同責任者ロン・レファーツ氏は「今回の提携により、顧客は信頼性が高く、適切に管理されたＬＳＥＧの『ティック・ヒストリー』から、より多様な方法で情報を得られるようになる。顧客は詳細な過去のデータを高速で処理したいと考えている」と述べた。

同社によると、ティック・ヒストリーには、５８０の取引所や取引施設、データ提供者から集めた３０年分のデータが収められている。対象は１億の金融商品で、データ量は約１１０兆行に上る。

items.title: ウクライナ首都などに攻撃、エネ施設標的　「米軽視」とゼレンスキー氏
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Dan Peleschuk

[１４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Dan Peleschuk

[１４日 ロイター] - ロシア軍は１３日夜から１４日未明にかけて首都キーウなどを攻撃した。キーウでは３人が死亡し、大規模な停電が発生した。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、トランプ米大統領の和平努力に対する「あからさまな軽視」だと非難した。

ゼレンスキー氏によると、主にキーウと第２の都市ハルキウがミサイルとドローン（無人機）による攻撃を受けた。エネルギー施設３０カ所が被害を受けた。少なくとも６０万人が停電の影響を受けているという。

同氏は「攻撃は完全に意図的であり、その規模を見せつけるものだった。ロシアはこれまで米国に対し、これほどあからさまな軽視を示したことはない」とＸに投稿。「ロシアは米大統領の発言に重みがないと見なしている」と指摘した。

コレツキー首相は、国内の国営鉄道施設も標的となったと述べた。

ロシア国防省は１４日、キーウとその周辺にある発電所４カ所、ハリコフの２カ所などを攻撃したと発表した。

ウクライナ空軍によると、ミサイル３９発中、迎撃できたのはわずか４発にとどまった。

items.title: IMF chief urges wealthy nations to tackle rising global debt levels
items.summary: That is forcing countries to make hard choices between supporting their most vulnerable people and meeting their debt repayment obligations ...
items.body:
Home / World News / IMF chief urges wealthy nations to tackle rising global debt levels

IMF chief urges wealthy nations to tackle rising global debt levels That is forcing countries to make hard choices between supporting their most vulnerable people and meeting their debt repayment obligations

IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva | Image: Bloomberg

AP Bangkok 3 min read Last Updated : Oct 14 2026 | 10:08 PM IST

Listen to This Article

The head of the International Monetary Fund said Wednesday that the US and other wealthy nations need to urgently tackle mounting global debt levels that are weighing heaviest on low-income countries and straining the global financial system.
IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva said that while US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and other US leaders recognise that the federal deficit and national debt have grown too high, just trying to grow the US economy out of its more than USD 40 trillion in national debt would not suffice.
"At the fund, we believe that, growth, of course, helps, but it cannot deliver fast enough the necessary adjustments," Georgieva said at the autumn meeting of the IMF and World Bank in Bangkok.
 

"There is no magic," she said, noting some other measures would be needed. "You have to go in a direction of tightening that, bringing it down, bringing deficit down."
Fiscal consolidation' faces challenges Rising debt levels and global inflation, partly resulting from high energy costs due to the Iran war, have pushed interest rates to multidecade highs, adding to the burdens of the world's poorest nations.
Also Read

Best of Opinion: Global growth headline numbers mask vulnerabilities

Global growth resilience premium

AI investment props up global growth, but war, debt threaten outlook: IMF

IMF raises India's growth forecast to 7% in FY27 on strong domestic demand

Global economy nears limits of resilience as energy squeeze persists: IMF

Efforts to bring debt under control with what Georgieva and other experts call "fiscal consolidation" have suffered setbacks from heavy spending during the COVID-19 pandemic and since.
"Fiscal risks are rising, and a proper reaction is largely absent in many countries," said Rodrigo Valdes, director of the IMF's Fiscal Affairs Department. "And in major advanced economies, the effect of fiscal indiscipline does not stop at the border. It travels to the rest of the world."   "Among the world's poorest countries, interest payments have reached historic highs relative to revenue, and declining amounts of aid are creating gaps that some countries have been unable to finance," the IMF's latest Fiscal Monitor said.

That is forcing countries to make hard choices between supporting their most vulnerable people and meeting their debt repayment obligations.
Nations need help with job creation, investment "We know that today the median developing country is going to pay, is actually today paying three times more on their interest repayments than developed countries," Alexander De Croo, former Belgian prime minister and the administrator of the United Nations Development Programme, said in an interview with The Associated Press.
On average nearly 10 per cent of government spending is going to repay debt, and the combination of high prices for fuel, fertiliser and other needs, the impact of the El Nino weather phenomenon and higher borrowing costs has left many low income countries with little opportunity to recover.

"I mean, we don't see really a light at the end of the tunnel," De Croo said.
Generating jobs, especially at a time when increasing use of artificial intelligence threatens to make many traditional occupations obsolete, is another top priority. More than 1.2 billion young people are expected to enter the global workforce in the next decade or so, while forecasts suggest a net creation of only 400 million new jobs.
The UNDP announced this week a "Jobs for Prosperity" initiative that will work with governments, development banks such as the World Bank and private businesses to encourage investment in key job creating areas such as tourism, healthcare and food processing.

The initiative and other efforts will focus on helping countries attract investment by improving their governance and policies, while creating pipelines of "investible projects," De Croo said.
"These are things that are feasible. It's been proven that you can do it in many places of the world.

items.title: ウクライナ、ロシア最大のデータセンター攻撃　業務に影響なし
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［モスクワ　１４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［モスクワ　１４日　ロイター］ - ロシア最大手の銀行ズベルバンクが所有する同国最大のデータセンターが、ウクライナの無人機の攻撃を受けた。同社幹部が１４日明らかにした。業務に影響は出ていないという。

この１週間に、ハイテク大手ヤンデックスが所有するデータセンターが３回にわたり攻撃を受けた。ウクライナ側は、自国のデータ施設に対するロシアの攻撃に対抗していると主張している。

ズベルバンクの幹部は記者団に対し、「データ処理センターが攻撃を受けたことは事実だ。ただ、ズベルバンクの全てのシステムとサービスは通常通り稼働しており、支障は出ていない」と述べた。

攻撃を受けたデータセンターは、サラトフ州のボルガ川沿いの都市バラコボにある。ロシア国営ＲＩＡノーボスチ通信は２０２４年に、同センターに国内最大のスーパーコンピューターが設置され、２７年に稼働予定と報じた。

items.title: ＥＵ、重要鉱物巡りベトナムとの関係強化目指す　中国依存低減へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Francesco Guarascio

[ハノイ １４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Francesco Guarascio

[ハノイ １４日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）は、中国への依存を減らすため、ベトナムからの重要鉱物の調達拡大を目指している。ロイターが確認したＥＵの内部文書で明らかになった。現在の供給が脅かされることへの懸念が背景にある。

ベトナムには、タングステン、レアアース、アンチモン、ビスマス、ボーキサイトなどの重要鉱物が豊富に埋蔵されている。ＥＵ向け輸出はこれまで、主にタングステンとアンチモンに限られてきた。いずれも弾薬や爆薬など、防衛分野で使われる。

ハノイのＥＵ代表部が作成した文書には「欧州が可能な限り迅速に再軍備とリスク低減を進める必要があることを踏まえると、特にレアアースとタングステンの埋蔵量が豊富なベトナムを、重要原材料の供給国候補として無視するわけにはいかない」と記されている。

２０２６年６月付の報告書と付属文書は、他国との調達競争がＥＵへの供給を妨げる恐れがあると警告。「特にタングステン、ビスマス、アンチモン、チタンの現在の調達経路を維持・拡大する」ため、ベトナムの鉱業・加工業への資金支援を提言した。

文書は、世界最大の重要鉱物生産国である「中国に代わる調達先を加える」ため、ベトナムとの関係強化が必要だと指摘した。
